d:
Babasir ke lie yog | Yoga for Piles - bavasir ke ilaj ke lie yogabhyas se pelvik manspeshiyon men khinchav aur toning se malashay aur guda dabanevala yantr ko aaram dene men madad mil sakti hai, jisse mal tyagna aasan ho jata hai.
Bavasir ke lie yog aasan aur oopar batae gae vyayam ka abhyas bavasir ke lakshanon se prabhavi dhang se nipatne men madad kar sakta hai. bavasir se bachav ke lie yog vyayam aur bavasir aasan bhi utkrisht vikalp hain. bavasir ke lie rojana malasan yog abhyas karne se sharir ko kaee phayde hote hain aur bavasir ke ilaj men madad mil sakti hai.
